findings.smallest_reproduction: D/native.py: CPython 3.12.3 recursion limit 150, depth 145 or 146; dispatch once and settle owner; native reader.pinned() exhausts stack with raw tuple pending; replace owner mapping account with earlier checkpoint; redispatch original admission.

findings.expected_result: Handed spend remains an unresolved/currentness obligation after interruption; stale original admission must refuse after rollback, executor_calls=1.
findings.trustscope: Execution-side owner handing/checkpoint replacement plus native caller stack exhaustion; no malicious serializer, private owner mutation, or source patch. Does not demonstrate external proposer bypass or execution of an unadmitted action (Q6/Q7 remain NO).
findings.proposed_correction: Choose a minimum stable owner handing contract: returned mapping membership and referenced histories must remain recoverable without rollback/rewriting until retained comparison completes. Owner-produced detached immutable snapshots whose lifetime follows reader references can meet this without an acknowledgement protocol. A fresh dict copy is sufficient for demonstrated mapping replacement only; general in-place history changes need stable history ownership too. Reader-only later normalization cannot reconstruct vanished state, and permanent retirement merely on resource failure violates honest-reader recovery. Do not assert that a full publication/acknowledgement system is necessary.
